claim_boundary: These records exist only to prove aperture mechanics. They are not observations, measurements, diagnoses, resident records, field receipts, completed work, offers, decisions, eligibility, or public program state.

plant.label: Fresh catnip bowl
plant.reading: A small household plant can be tracked as a living object with pet access, touch checks, moisture, drainage, use, and care history.
plant.uncertainty: No real plant, sensor, diagnosis, moisture value, pet interaction, or care event is represented.

plant.label: Touch-check care branch
plant.reading: The next action depends on a household touch check rather than a fabricated sensor value or generic watering schedule.
plant.uncertainty: The correct care action for any real plant remains unknown until an accountable person observes it.

household.label: Household habitat envelope
household.reading: The household aperture relates plant access, shade, drainage, storage, pets, tools, and resident acceptance without exposing an address or resident identity.
household.uncertainty: No real household layout, resident preference, hazard, consent, equipment, or work condition is represented.

household.label: Resident acceptance boundary
household.reading: A steward proposal remains a proposal until the affected household actor accepts the scope, timing, access, and completion evidence.
household.uncertainty: No real resident has accepted or refused anything.

stewardship.label: Bounded assistance offer
stewardship.reading: A program offer names the need, evidence, authority, resources, limits, acceptance, refusal, appeal, execution, and follow-through instead of producing one punitive score.
stewardship.uncertainty: No real program, funding, eligibility, resident, offer, decision, or execution is represented.

stewardship.label: Assistance-oriented hotspot triage
stewardship.reading: A hotspot can trigger verification and assistance routing while insurance, enforcement, property scoring, and adverse action remain prohibited.
stewardship.uncertainty: No real hotspot, parcel, incident, household, insurance status, or remediation need is represented.

prohibited_uses: presentation as observed or measured evidence
plant diagnosis or watering instruction for a real plant
private household record or resident preference
parcel, street, neighborhood, or regional condition determination
inspection, entry, work, completed-remediation, assistance, eligibility, insurance, enforcement, or other adverse action
public release or canonical task-count mutation
control_question: Can an operator distinguish every authored demonstration field from source-backed evidence and refuse to transfer its authority into a real household, field, program, or public decision?
